framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4
palette: Hard-coded hex classes (#4A7C8A teal, #3A6270 deep teal, #2A4A52 ink, #C8722A orange, #F5F0E8 cream, #E8DFC8 sand, #FEFCF8 paper); --background/--foreground in src/app/globals.css. Preserved and lifted into OKLCH role tokens in tokens.css.
motion: No motion library; CSS keyframes in globals.css, prefers-reduced-motion override present
spacing: Tailwind default scale; safe-x/safe-top/safe-bottom utilities. Role-named --space-* added in tokens.css
designMd: design.md written at project root (multi-page system)
introduced: Bento Grid home with H2 hero
